landing.heroDescription: ORLOJ is a public, audited index of Model Context Protocol servers wired to on‑chain contracts. Publish yours; or browse a thousand and let your agent ring the bells.
landing.twoPathsTitle: Bring an interface, or take one home.
landing.twoPathsSubtitle: The registry forks here. Builders publish; operators browse and bind. Choose your gate.
landing.buildersGateBody: Paste a verified contract address. ORLOJ derives the ABI, generates a tool manifest, runs static checks, and lists it under your ENS. Takes about ninety seconds.
landing.operatorsGateBody: Search 142 published interfaces by chain, capability, audit posture, and call volume. Bind any to one of your agents in two clicks.
landing.mechanismSubtitle: ORLOJ behaves like Prague's astronomical clock — public, deterministic, and slightly theatrical.
landing.step1Desc: Register your agent and seal their private keys in a vault — secure by default, never exposed.
landing.step2Desc: Paste a contract address. We resolve the ABI and generate a ready‑to‑use MCP server in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Let the agent wield the MCPs and move onchain seamlessly — call by call, permission by permission.

register.title: Cast a new bell
register.subtitle: Paste a verified contract. ORLOJ resolves the ABI and forges the interface.
register.rpcHint: Optional — leave blank to use the default public endpoint.
register.chainIdHint: Numeric chain ID of the network (e.g. 42161 for Arbitrum).
register.howItWorksDesc: ORLOJ fetches the verified ABI from Sourcify, resolves proxy implementations, and generates a typed MCP server you can bind to any agent in one command.
register.howItWorksNativeDesc: ORLOJ registers the chain's native currency (ETH, MATIC, etc.) as an MCP server, exposing balance and transfer tools any agent can use directly.
